title: Thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure (axisymmetric slice, axially constrained ends)
description:
Thick-walled steel cylinder under internal pressure, axisymmetric model. Coordinates: x = r (radius, axis of revolution at x = 0), y = z (axial). A slice of axial height H of the wall is modelled (STEP: a planar rectangle in the xy-plane = the r-z half-plane).
Geometry: rectangle a <= r <= b, 0 <= z <= H with bore radius a = 0.1 m, outer radius b = 0.2 m, H = 0.05 m. Edges: bore r = a, outer surface r = b, ends z = 0 and z = H.
Material: linear elastic, E = 2e+11 Pa, nu = 0.3.
Loads: uniform internal pressure p = 1e+08 Pa (100 MPa) on the bore r = a. Outer surface r = b traction free.
Supports: Both end faces z = 0 and z = H are restrained axially (u_z = 0) and free radially: the slice represents a long cylinder whose axial strain is zero (plane strain).
Report (SI units):
  ur_bore      radial displacement at the bore, u_r at (r, z) = (a, H/2) [m]
  hoop_bore    hoop stress at the bore, sigma_theta at (a, H/2) [Pa]
  szz_bore     axial stress sigma_zz at (a, H/2) [Pa]
  vm_max       maximum von Mises stress [Pa]
  strain_energy total strain energy of the modelled slice, full 360 degrees [J]
